clues.text: This town sits by a lake. It is in the heart of Burkina Faso, north of the capital.
clues.narrowing: rules out everything outside central Burkina Faso, north of the capital

source.quote: Kongoussi benefits from a lakeside location, which is rare in the African Sahel.

clues.text: Though the land around is arid and dry, the lake lets people farm its shore all year round.
clues.narrowing: rules out dry Sahel towns with no lake to farm beside all year

source.quote: The lake, Lac du Bam is part of the upper reaches of the southward-flowing Volta system, and its presence permits year-round lakeshore cultivation in an otherwise arid climate.

clues.text: France set up an outpost here and built roads. It backed cotton, but changed local life very little.
clues.narrowing: rules out Sahel lake towns with no French outpost and cotton history

source.quote: France had little real impact on the local population but did establish an outpost, promoted cotton production, and built roads.

clues.text: Green beans are grown here, and they are sold in Paris. In winter, they fill the market there.
clues.narrowing: rules out all but the Sahel lake town that sends green beans to Paris in winter

source.quote: Aside from tropical fruits, green beans are produced here, usually supplying the winter market in Paris when flights form Ouagadougou permit this.

clues.text: A big Catholic mission stands by the lake. It sits on the east shore of Lac du Bam.
clues.narrowing: confirms the town on the east shore mission of Lac du Bam

source.quote: It has a small hospital, a large Catholic mission on the eastern shores of the Lac du Bam, a small number of rudimentary hotels, primary and secondary schools, a cinema and a large market.
